response.justification: Bogdan is a strong senior individual contributor with ~18 years of software development experience and genuine developer-tooling interests (test runners, assertion libraries, CI/DevOps setup, MCP code generators), but the resume shows no formal people management experience, no evidence of setting team roadmaps, performance management, or leading organizational change. For a Level II Engineering Manager role, the core requirement of 2+ years of people leadership and 3+ years technical leadership of teams is not demonstrated, making him a poor fit despite solid technical depth.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience (18+ years) across web, mobile, embedded, and high-scale systems
Authentic developer-tools and testing-infrastructure background (Trial test runner, Fluent-Asserts, CI/CD, Selenium training, MCP tooling)
Strong knowledge-sharing track record via workshops, courses, and conference talks
concerns: No evidence of formal people management (one-on-ones, performance reviews, hiring, team development)
No demonstrated experience owning team roadmaps or leading organizational change
Mobile experience is limited and dated (one iOS/Apple TV stint in 2015–2016), weak for a mobile-platform ecosystem focus

key_factors.factor: Developer tools and testing infrastructure background
